ko.title: 56,000명의 주민, 하나의 영구 기지: 그린란드를 둘러싼 미-덴마크 협약 내부

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## 수년에 걸친 협약

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: 대서양을 건너 동맹국들을 불안하게 만든 수개월간의 고조된 수사 이후, 미국과 덴마크는 세계에서 가장 큰 섬이자 약 56,000명의 주민이 거주하는 그린란드의 미래를 다루는 협약에 도달했습니다.

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: 이 협약은 영토에 대한 덴마크의 주권을 명시적으로 보존하면서 그린란드 땅에 상당하고 영구적인 미국 군사 주둔을 설립합니다 — 최근 기억 속 두 NATO 동맹국 간의 가장 이례적인 외교적 대치 중 하나를 진정시키기 위해 설계된 타협입니다.

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: 이 협약은 트럼프 대통령이 미국이 그린란드의 전략적 위치와 광물 부의를 인용하여 그린란드를 인수하거나 완전히 통제해야 한다는 아이디어를 반복적으로 제시한 기간을 따릅니다.

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: 덴마크 및 그린란드 관리들은 섬의 정치적 지위가 협상 대상이라는 어떤 제안에도 단호하고 일관되게 반발했으며, 그린란드의 미래에 관한 결정이 그린란드 주민들 자신과 자치권의 조건 하에서 코펜하겐에 있어야 한다고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## 협약이 실제로 말하는 것

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: 영토 양도보다는, 협약은 섬의 북서쪽에 있는 Pituffik 우주 기지(구 Thule 공군기지)와 연결된 수십 년 된 방위 협정을 바탕으로 하는 확대되고 영구적인 미국 군사 발자국을 중심으로 한다고 보도됩니다.

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: 관리들이 설명한 핵심 요소들은 다음을 포함합니다:

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **덴마크 주권의 지속** — 그린란드는 덴마크 왕국의 일부로 남으며, Nuuk의 자체 정부는 국내 문제에 대한 권한을 유지합니다.

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **영구적인 미국 기지 주둔** — 기존 발자국을 넘어 미국 군사 기반 시설과 인원을 확대하며, 임시 주둔보다는 장기적인 안보 약속으로 표현됩니다.

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **경쟁 국가에 대한 강경한 입장** — 중국과 러시아가 섬의 어디든지 군사, 항구 또는 이중 용도 기반 시설을 설립하는 것을 영구적으로 차단하기 위한 조항.

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **계속된 그린란드의 자치** — Nuuk이 자체 영토에 영향을 미치는 결정에서 발언권을 유지할 것으로 예상되며, 자치권 지위와 일치합니다.

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: 어느 정부도 전체 법적 텍스트를 공개적으로 공개하지 않았으며, 세부 사항은 여전히 드러나고 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 기지 권리, 자원 접근, 그리고 재정 약속에 대한 최종 언어가 광범위한 체계만큼 중요할 것이라고 경고합니다.

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## 왜 그린란드인가, 왜 지금인가

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: 그린란드의 대국 경쟁에 대한 관련성은 지난 10년간 급격히 증가했습니다.

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: 녹아드는 북극 얼음은 새로운 해운 항로를 열고 방위 및 청정 에너지 공급망에 필수적인 희토류 원소 및 기타 광물의 미개발 매장량을 노출하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: 북미와 유럽 사이의 위치는 또한 미사일 경보 레이더와 위성 추적을 위한 자연스러운 노드가 되게 합니다 — Pituffik이 냉전 이후로 수행해온 역할입니다.

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: 중국은 수년간 북극에서 광산과 기반 시설 발판을 추구해왔으며, 러시아는 이 지역에서 자체 군사 주둔을 꾸준히 확대해왔습니다.

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: 그린란드의 더 큰 발자국에 대한 워싱턴의 공개적 근거는 그 자체를 위한 영토적 야망보다는 정확히 그러한 종류의 침해를 사전에 차단하는 데 집중되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## Nuuk과 코펜하겐으로부터의 반응

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: 그린란드 지도자들은 덴마크로부터 더 큰 독립에 대한 욕망과 더 가까운 미국 통제 아래 떨어질 가능성에 대한 경계심 사이의 균형을 오래도록 유지해왔으며, 섬의 정치적 지위를 변경하지 않는 결과에 대해 신중한 수용을 신호했습니다.

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: 덴마크 관리들은 자신들의 부분에서 협약을 양보보다는 이례적인 긴장의 시기 이후 대서양횡단 동맹의 재확인으로 표현했습니다.

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: 유럽 관리들은 미국이 그린란드에 대해 일방적으로 행동하면 동맹국과 파트너 영토의 주권과 관련하여 달갑지 않은 선례를 설정할 수 있다는 경계심을 가지고 분쟁을 밀접하게 지켜봤습니다.

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: 협상된 결과 — 기존 주권을 존중하는 대신 확대된 기지 권리 — 유럽 수도에서 안심할 수 있는 해결책으로 읽힐 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 다음은 무엇인가

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
segments.tr: 새로운 미국 기반 시설의 규모, 군대 수, 그린란드 및 덴마크와의 경제적 배치를 포함한 구현 세부 사항은 후속 협상에서 작업될 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 워싱턴과 코펜하겐의 입법자들은 또한 협약의 요소가 최종화되기 전에 의견을 제시할 수 있으며, 그린란드의 자체 의회는 향후 몇 개월 동안 협약이 구현될 때 자신의 이익이 보호된 상태로 유지되도록 보장을 요청할 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: 지금으로서는 협약은 미국-유럽 동맹의 내구성에 대한 질문을 잠깐 제기한 분쟁의 주목할 만한 진정을 표시합니다 — 적어도 지금으로는 섬을 누가 통치하는지 변경하는 것이 아니라 확대된 군사 협력을 통해 해결되었습니다.

zh.title: 5.6万名居民，一个永久基地：美丹格陵兰岛协议内幕

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## 多年谈判的协议

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: 经过数月不断升级的言论引发大西洋两岸盟国不安之后，美国与丹麦就格陵兰岛的未来达成了一项协议。格陵兰岛是世界上最大的岛屿，约有56,000人居住在此。

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: 该协议在格陵兰岛建立了一个重要的、永久性的美国军事存在，同时明确保护丹麦对该领土的主权——这是一项旨在缓解两个北约盟国之间近期一项不寻常外交对峙的妥协方案。

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: 该协议是在特朗普总统多次提出美国应彻底收购或控制格陵兰岛想法之后达成的，他引用了该岛的战略位置和矿产财富。

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: 丹麦和格陵兰岛官员坚决而一致地反对任何关于该岛政治地位可被协商的暗示，坚持格陵兰岛未来的决定权掌握在格陵兰人自己手中，以及根据自治条款，掌握在哥本哈根手中。

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## 协议究竟说了什么

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: 据报道，该协议不是领土转移，而是主要涉及扩大和永久性美国军事存在，这是基于与位于该岛西北部的皮图菲克空间基地（原名图勒空军基地）相关的数十年防御协议之上。

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: 官员们描述的关键要素包括：

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **继续保持丹麦主权**——格陵兰岛仍然是丹麦王国的一部分，其努克政府保留了对国内事务的权威。

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **美国永久基地存在**——超出现有范围扩展美国军事基础设施和人员，被视为长期安全承诺而非临时派驻。

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **对竞争大国的强硬立场**——旨在永久阻止中国和俄罗斯在岛上任何地方建立军事、港口或双用途基础设施的条款。

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **继续格陵兰岛自治**——努克预期在影响其领土的决定中保持话语权，与其自治地位一致。

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: 两国政府都没有公开发布完整的法律文本，细节仍在浮出水面。

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: 分析人士警告，关于基地权利、资源获取和财务承诺的最终措辞将与广泛框架一样重要。

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## 为什么选择格陵兰岛，为什么现在

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: 在过去十年里，格陵兰岛与大国竞争的相关性急剧增长。

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: 融化的北极冰正在开辟新的运输航线，并暴露出对防务和清洁能源供应链至关重要的未开采稀土元素和其他矿物。

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: 其位于北美和欧洲之间的位置也使其成为导弹预警雷达和卫星追踪的自然节点——这是皮图菲克自冷战以来一直扮演的角色。

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: 多年来中国一直在寻求北极地区的采矿和基础设施立足点，而俄罗斯则稳步扩大了其在该地区的军事存在。

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: 华盛顿对扩大格陵兰岛军事存在的公开理由是为了抢先防止这种侵蚀，而非出于领土野心本身。

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## 努克和哥本哈根的反应

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: 格陵兰岛领导人长期以来一直在渴望获得更大的丹麦独立性与对陷入美国更严密控制的警惕之间平衡，他们对保持该岛政治地位不变的结果表示谨慎接受。

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: 丹麦官员则将该协议视为大西洋两岸联盟在经历一段不寻常紧张后的重申，而非让步。

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: 欧洲官员密切关注了这场争端，担心美国对格陵兰岛的任何单方面行动都可能为盟国和伙伴领土的主权设定一个不受欢迎的先例。

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: 协商的结果——以扩大基地权利来换取尊重现有主权——可能会被欧洲首都解读为令人放心的解决方案。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
segments.tr: 实施细节，包括新美国基础设施的规模、部队数量以及与格陵兰岛和丹麦的任何经济安排，预计将在后续谈判中制定。

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 华盛顿和哥本哈根的议员也可能在该协议的某些要素最终确定前表态，格陵兰岛议会可能会寻求保证，在未来几个月实施该协议时其利益保持受保护。

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: 目前，该协议标志着一项争端的显著缓解，该争端曾短暂地引发了关于美欧联盟耐久性的质疑——至少在目前，通过扩大军事合作而非改变谁统治该岛的方式得以解决。

hi.title: 56,000 निवासी, एक स्थायी अड्डा: ग्रीनलैंड पर अमेरिका-डेनमार्क सौदे के अंदर

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## एक लंबे समय का सौदा

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: अटलांटिक महासागर के पार मित्र राष्ट्रों को व्यथित करने वाली महीनों की तीव्र वार्ता के बाद, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका और डेनमार्क ने ग्रीनलैंड के भविष्य पर एक समझौते पर पहुंचे हैं, जो दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा द्वीप है और लगभग 56,000 लोगों का घर है।

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: यह व्यवस्था ग्रीनलैंड की मिट्टी पर एक महत्वपूर्ण, स्थायी अमेरिकी सैन्य उपस्थिति स्थापित करती है जबकि स्पष्ट रूप से इस क्षेत्र पर डेनिश संप्रभुता को संरक्षित रखती है — यह एक समझौता है जो दो नाटो सहयोगियों के बीच हाल की असामान्य राजनयिक गतिरोध को शांत करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: यह समझौता एक अवधि के बाद आता है जिसमें राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प ने बार-बार यह विचार सामने रखा कि संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका को ग्रीनलैंड को पूरी तरह से प्राप्त या नियंत्रित करना चाहिए, इसके रणनीतिक स्थान और खनिज संपदा का हवाला देते हुए।

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: डेनिश और ग्रीनलैंडिक अधिकारियों ने द्वीप की राजनीतिक स्थिति के किसी भी सुझाव को दृढ़ता से और लगातार खारिज किया, जोर देते हुए कि ग्रीनलैंड के भविष्य के बारे में निर्णय ग्रीनलैंडर स्वयं के पास रहते हैं और गृह शासन की शर्तों के तहत कोपेनहेगन के पास हैं।

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## समझौता वास्तव में क्या कहता है

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: क्षेत्र के हस्तांतरण के बजाय, यह सौदा कथित तौर पर एक विस्तारित और स्थायी अमेरिकी सैन्य उपस्थिति पर केंद्रित है, जो द्वीप के उत्तर-पश्चिम में Pituffik Space Base (पहले Thule Air Base) से जुड़ी दशकों पुरानी रक्षा व्यवस्था पर आधारित है।

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: अधिकारियों द्वारा वर्णित मुख्य तत्व शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **डेनिश संप्रभुता जारी रहती है** — ग्रीनलैंड डेनमार्क राज्य का हिस्सा बना रहता है, इसकी अपनी सरकार Nuuk में घरेलू मामलों पर अधिकार बनाए रखती है।

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **एक स्थायी अमेरिकी सैन्य अड्डा** — मौजूदा उपस्थिति से परे अमेरिकी सैन्य बुनियादी ढांचे और कर्मियों का विस्तार, जिसे एक अस्थायी तैनाती के बजाय एक दीर्घकालीन सुरक्षा प्रतिबद्धता के रूप में तैयार किया गया है।

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिद्वंद्वी शक्तियों के प्रति कठोर रुख** — ऐसे प्रावधान जो चीन और रूस को द्वीप पर कहीं भी सैन्य, बंदरगाह या द्वैध उपयोग बुनियादी ढांचा स्थापित करने से स्थायी रूप से रोकने के लिए हैं।

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **ग्रीनलैंडिक आत्मशासन जारी रहता है** — Nuuk के साथ अपने क्षेत्र को प्रभावित करने वाले निर्णयों में आवाज बनाए रखने की अपेक्षा की जाती है, जो इसकी गृह शासन स्थिति के अनुरूप है।

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: किसी भी सरकार ने पूर्ण कानूनी पाठ सार्वजनिक रूप से जारी नहीं किया है, और विवरण अभी भी सामने आ रहे हैं।

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों को चेतावनी देते हुए कि बेसिंग अधिकार, संसाधन पहुंच, और वित्तीय प्रतिबद्धताओं पर अंतिम भाषा व्यापक ढांचे जितना ही महत्वपूर्ण होगी।

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## ग्रीनलैंड, क्यों अब

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: महाशक्ति प्रतियोगिता में ग्रीनलैंड की प्रासंगिकता पिछले दशक में तेजी से बढ़ी है।

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: पिघलती आर्कटिक बर्फ नई शिपिंग लेन खोल रही है और दुर्लभ पृथ्वी तत्वों और अन्य खनिजों के अप्रयुक्त जमा को उजागर कर रही है जो रक्षा और स्वच्छ ऊर्जा आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: उत्तरी अमेरिका और यूरोप के बीच इसकी स्थिति इसे मिसाइल-चेतावनी रडार और उपग्रह ट्रैकिंग के लिए एक प्राकृतिक नोड बनाती है — एक भूमिका जो Pituffik ने शीत युद्ध से खेली है।

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: चीन वर्षों से आर्कटिक में खनन और बुनियादी ढांचे के पैर जमाने की कोशिश कर रहा है, जबकि रूस ने इस क्षेत्र में अपनी सैन्य उपस्थिति को लगातार बढ़ाया है।

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन का ग्रीनलैंड में एक बड़ी उपस्थिति के लिए जनता का तर्क बिल्कुल उसी तरह की अतिक्रमण को रोकने पर केंद्रित है, बजाय अपने लिए क्षेत्रीय महत्वाकांक्षा के।

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## Nuuk और कोपेनहेगन से प्रतिक्रिया

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: ग्रीनलैंडिक नेताओं, जिन्होंने लंबे समय से डेनमार्क से अधिक स्वतंत्रता की इच्छा को अमेरिकी नियंत्रण में पड़ने की चिंता के साथ संतुलित किया है, ने एक परिणाम की सावधानीपूर्ण स्वीकृति का संकेत दिया है जो द्वीप की राजनीतिक स्थिति को अपरिवर्तित रखता है।

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: डेनिश अधिकारियों ने, अपनी ओर से, इस सौदे को असामान्य तनाव की अवधि के बाद अटलांटिक पार गठबंधन की पुष्टि के रूप में तैयार किया है, न कि एक रियायत के रूप में।

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: यूरोपीय अधिकारियों ने विवाद को बारीकी से देखा, इस बात से सावधान कि ग्रीनलैंड पर कोई भी एकतरफा अमेरिकी कदम सहयोगी और भागीदार क्षेत्रों की संप्रभुता के संबंध में एक अवांछनीय मिसाल स्थापित कर सकता है।

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: वार्ता का परिणाम — मौजूदा संप्रभुता के सम्मान के बदले विस्तारित बेसिंग अधिकार — यूरोपीय राजधानियों में एक आश्वस्तकर समाधान के रूप में पढ़ा जाने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## अगला क्या

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
segments.tr: कार्यान्वयन विवरण, नई अमेरिकी बुनियादी ढांचे के पैमाने, सैनिक संख्या, और ग्रीनलैंड और डेनमार्क के साथ किसी भी आर्थिक व्यवस्था सहित, अनुवर्ती बातचीत में काम किया जाने की अपेक्षा की जाती है।

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन और कोपेनहेगन दोनों में विधायकों को भी सौदे के तत्वों को अंतिम रूप दिए जाने से पहले वजन करने के लिए कहा जा सकता है, और ग्रीनलैंड की अपनी संसद आश्वस्त करने की मांग करने की संभावना है कि आने वाले महीनों में समझौते को लागू किया जाने के दौरान इसके हित सुरक्षित रहें।

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: अब के लिए, यह सौदा एक विवाद के एक उल्लेखनीय शांतिकरण को चिह्नित करता है जिसने संक्षिप्त रूप से अमेरिकी-यूरोपीय गठबंधन की स्थायित्व के बारे में सवाल उठाए — कम से कम अभी के लिए हल किया गया, द्वीप पर किसी के शासन में परिवर्तन के बजाय विस्तारित सैन्य सहयोग के माध्यम से।

es.title: 56.000 Residentes, Una Base Permanente: Dentro del Acuerdo Estados Unidos-Dinamarca Sobre Groenlandia

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## Un Acuerdo Años en la Realización

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: Después de meses de retórica escalada que inquietó a los aliados del otro lado del Atlántico, Estados Unidos y Dinamarca han llegado a un acuerdo sobre el futuro de Groenlandia, la isla más grande del mundo y hogar de aproximadamente 56.000 personas.

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: El arreglo establece una presencia militar estadounidense significativa y permanente en territorio groenlandés mientras preserva explícitamente la soberanía danesa sobre el territorio — un compromiso diseñado para desescalar uno de los enfrentamientos diplomáticos más inusuales entre dos aliados de la OTAN en memoria reciente.

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: El acuerdo sigue a un período en el que el Presidente Trump repetidamente sugirió la idea de que Estados Unidos debería adquirir u obtener el control total de Groenlandia, citando su ubicación estratégica y riqueza mineral.

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios daneses y groenlandeses rechazaron firmemente y consistentemente cualquier sugerencia de que el estado político de la isla estuviera abierto a negociación, insistiendo en que las decisiones sobre el futuro de Groenlandia descansan en los propios groenlandeses y, bajo los términos del autogobierno, con Copenhague.

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## Lo que el Acuerdo Realmente Dice

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: Más que una transferencia territorial, el trato supuestamente se centra en una huella militar estadounidense expandida y permanente, construida sobre el arreglo de defensa de décadas de antigüedad vinculado a la Base Espacial Pituffik (anteriormente Base Aérea Thule) en el noroeste de la isla.

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: Los elementos clave descritos por funcionarios incluyen:

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **Soberanía danesa continuada** — Groenlandia sigue siendo parte del Reino de Dinamarca, con su propio gobierno en Nuuk manteniendo autoridad sobre asuntos internos.

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **Una presencia permanente de base estadounidense** — expandiendo infraestructura militar estadounidense y personal más allá de la huella existente, enmarcada como un compromiso de seguridad a largo plazo en lugar de una asignación temporal.

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **Una línea dura contra potencias rivales** — disposiciones destinadas a bloquear permanentemente a China y Rusia de establecer infraestructura militar, portuaria o de doble uso en ningún lugar de la isla.

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **Autogobierno groenlandés continuado** — con Nuuk esperado retener una voz en decisiones que afecten su propio territorio, consistente con su estado de autogobierno.

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: Ninguno de los dos gobiernos ha liberado el texto legal completo públicamente, y los detalles aún están emergiendo.

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: Los analistas advierten que el lenguaje final sobre derechos de base, acceso a recursos y compromisos financieros importará tanto como el marco general.

segments.tr: ## Reacción Desde Nuuk y Copenhague

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios europeos habían observado la disputa de cerca, cautelosos de que cualquier movimiento unilateral estadounidense sobre Groenlandia pudiera establecer un precedente no deseado respecto a la soberanía de territorios aliados y asociados.

segments.tr: Se espera que los detalles de implementación, incluyendo la escala de nueva infraestructura estadounidense, números de tropas y cualquier arreglo económico con Groenlandia y Dinamarca, se resuelvan en conversaciones de seguimiento.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Los legisladores en Washington y Copenhague también pueden pesar antes de que elementos del trato sean finalizados, y el propio parlamento de Groenlandia es probable que busque garantías de que sus intereses permanecen protegidos mientras el acuerdo se implementa en los meses venideros.

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: Por ahora, el trato marca una desescalada notable de una disputa que brevemente planteó preguntas sobre la durabilidad de las alianzas estadounidenses-europeas — resuelta, al menos por el momento, a través de cooperación militar expandida en lugar de un cambio en quién gobierna la isla.

ar.title: 56,000 نسمة، قاعدة دائمة واحدة: داخل صفقة الولايات المتحدة والدنمارك حول جرينلاند

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## صفقة تم إبرامها على مدى سنوات

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: بعد أشهر من الخطاب المتصاعد الذي أربك الحلفاء عبر الأطلسي، توصلت الولايات المتحدة والدنمارك إلى اتفاق يغطي مستقبل جرينلاند، أكبر جزيرة في العالم وموطن حوالي 56,000 نسمة.

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: يضع الترتيب وجودًا عسكريًا أمريكيًا دائمًا وكبيرًا على الأراضي الجرينلندية مع الحفاظ الصريح على السيادة الدنماركية على الأراضي — وهي تسوية مصممة لتخفيف حدة أحد أغرب المواجهات الدبلوماسية بين حليفي الناتو اللذين يتذكرهما الجميع في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: تأتي الاتفاقية بعد فترة اقترح فيها الرئيس ترامب بشكل متكرر فكرة أن الولايات المتحدة يجب أن تستحوذ على جرينلاند بشكل كامل أو تسيطر عليها بطريقة أخرى، مستشهدًا بموقعها الاستراتيجي وثروتها المعدنية.

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: رفض المسؤولون الدنماركيون والجرينلنديون بقوة واستمرار أي اقتراح بأن الوضع السياسي للجزيرة مفتوح للتفاوض، مؤكدين أن القرارات المتعلقة بمستقبل جرينلاند تعود للجرينلنديين أنفسهم وبموجب شروط الحكم الذاتي مع كوبنهاغن.

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## ما تقوله الاتفاقية بالفعل

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: بدلاً من نقل الأراضي، تركز الصفقة على توسيع وتدعيم النشاط العسكري الأمريكي الدائم، بناءً على ترتيب الدفاع الذي يعود لعقود من الزمن والمرتبط بقاعدة بيتوفيك الفضائية (المعروفة سابقًا باسم قاعدة ثول الجوية) في شمال غرب الجزيرة.

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: تشمل العناصر الرئيسية التي وصفها المسؤولون ما يلي:

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **استمرار السيادة الدنماركية** — تبقى جرينلاند جزءًا من مملكة الدنمارك، مع احتفاظ حكومتها في نوك بالسلطة على الشؤون المحلية.

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **وجود قاعدة أمريكية دائمة** — توسيع البنية التحتية والقوى العاملة العسكرية الأمريكية بما يتجاوز الوجود الحالي، معروضة كالتزام أمني طويل الأجل وليس كنشر مؤقت.

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **موقف صارم تجاه القوى المنافسة** — أحكام تهدف إلى منع الصين وروسيا بشكل دائم من إقامة البنى التحتية العسكرية أو الموانئ أو ذات الاستخدام المزدوج في أي مكان على الجزيرة.

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **استمرار الحكم الذاتي الجرينلندي** — مع توقع احتفاظ نوك بصوت في القرارات التي تؤثر على أراضيها، وهو ما يتسق مع وضع الحكم الذاتي.

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: لم تكشف أي من الحكومتين عن النص القانوني الكامل علنًا، والتفاصيل لا تزال تظهر.

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: يحذر المحللون من أن الصيغة النهائية بشأن حقوق القاعدة والوصول إلى الموارد والالتزامات المالية ستكون مهمة بقدر الإطار العام.

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## لماذا جرينلاند، ولماذا الآن

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: ازدادت أهمية جرينلاند للمنافسة بين القوى العظمى بشكل حاد على مدى العقد الماضي.

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: يفتح ذوبان جليد القطب الشمالي ممرات شحن جديدة ويكشف عن رواسب غير مستكشفة من عناصر الأرض النادرة والمعادن الأخرى الحاسمة لسلاسل إمدادات الدفاع والطاقة النظيفة.

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: كما أن موقعها بين أمريكا الشمالية وأوروبا يجعلها عقدة طبيعية لرادار تحذير الصواريخ وتتبع الأقمار الصناعية — دور لعبته بيتوفيك منذ الحرب الباردة.

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: سعت الصين للحصول على مواطئ قدم في التعدين والبنية التحتية في القطب الشمالي لسنوات، بينما وسعت روسيا بشكل مطرد وجودها العسكري في المنطقة.

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: كان المبرر العام لواشنطن لتعزيز وجودها في جرينلاند مركزًا على منع هذا النوع من التعدي تحديدًا، بدلاً من الطموح الإقليمي لذاته.

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## رد الفعل من نوك وكوبنهاغن

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: أشار قادة جرينلاند، الذين وازنوا طويلاً بين رغبتهم في الاستقلال الأكبر عن الدنمارك والحذر من الوقوع تحت السيطرة الأمريكية الأقرب، إلى قبول حذر لنتيجة تحافظ على الوضع السياسي للجزيرة دون تغيير.

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: قام المسؤولون الدنماركيون، من جانبهم، بتأطير الصفقة كإعادة تأكيد للحلف عبر الأطلسي بعد فترة من التوتر غير المعتاد، وليس كتنازل.

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: راقب المسؤولون الأوروبيون النزاع عن كثب، خائفين من أن أي خطوة أمريكية أحادية الجانب بشأن جرينلاند قد تضع سابقة غير مرحب بها فيما يتعلق بسيادة الأراضي الحليفة والشريكة.

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: من المحتمل أن يتم قراءة النتيجة المفاوضة — توسيع حقوق القاعدة مقابل احترام السيادة القائمة — في العواصم الأوروبية كحل مطمئن.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ما هو الآتي

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
segments.tr: من المتوقع أن يتم الاتفاق على تفاصيل التنفيذ، بما في ذلك نطاق البنية التحتية الأمريكية الجديدة وأعداد القوات والترتيبات الاقتصادية مع جرينلاند والدنمارك، في محادثات لاحقة.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: قد يدلي صناع القرار في واشنطن وكوبنهاغن أيضًا برأيهم قبل استكمال عناصر الصفقة، ومن المحتمل أن يسعى البرلمان الجرينلندي إلى التأكيدات بأن مصالحه تبقى محمية مع تنفيذ الاتفاقية في الأشهر القادمة.

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، تمثل الصفقة تخفيفًا ملحوظًا لنزاع أثار بإيجاز تساؤلات حول متانة التحالفات الأمريكية الأوروبية — تم حلها، على الأقل في الوقت الحالي، من خلال توسيع التعاون العسكري بدلاً من تغيير من يحكم الجزيرة.

fr.title: 56 000 Résidents, Une Base Permanente: À l'Intérieur de l'Accord États-Unis-Danemark sur le Groenland

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## Un Accord en Préparation Depuis des Années

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: Après des mois de rhétorique croissante qui a troublé les alliés de l'autre côté de l'Atlantique, les États-Unis et le Danemark ont conclu un accord couvrant l'avenir du Groenland, la plus grande île du monde et foyer d'environ 56 000 personnes.

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: L'arrangement établit une présence militaire américaine significative et permanente sur le sol groenlandais tout en préservant explicitement la souveraineté danoise sur le territoire — un compromis conçu pour désamorcer l'un des affrontements diplomatiques les plus inhabituels entre deux alliés de l'OTAN dans les mémoires récentes.

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: L'accord suit une période au cours de laquelle le président Trump a à plusieurs reprises proposé l'idée que les États-Unis devraient acquérir ou contrôler autrement le Groenland purement et simplement, citant son emplacement stratégique et sa richesse minérale.

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: Les autorités danoises et groenlandaises se sont opposées fermement et régulièrement à toute suggestion que le statut politique de l'île était ouvert à la négociation, insistant sur le fait que les décisions concernant l'avenir du Groenland reposaient sur les Groenlandais eux-mêmes et, selon les termes de l'autonomie, sur Copenhague.

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## Ce que l'Accord Dit Vraiment

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: Plutôt qu'un transfert de territoire, l'accord s'articulerait autour d'une présence militaire américaine élargie et permanente, s'appuyant sur l'accord de défense vieux de plusieurs décennies lié à la base spatiale Pituffik (anciennement base aérienne Thule) dans le nord-ouest de l'île.

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: Les éléments clés décrits par les autorités comprennent:

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **Souveraineté danoise continue** — Le Groenland reste partie du Royaume du Danemark, avec son propre gouvernement à Nuuk conservant l'autorité sur les affaires intérieures.

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **Une présence de base américaine permanente** — expansion de l'infrastructure militaire américaine et du personnel au-delà de la présence actuelle, présentée comme un engagement de sécurité à long terme plutôt qu'une affectation temporaire.

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **Une ligne dure contre les puissances rivales** — des dispositions destinées à bloquer définitivement la Chine et la Russie de l'établissement d'une infrastructure militaire, portuaire ou à double usage n'importe où sur l'île.

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **Autonomie gouvernementale groenlandaise continue** — Nuuk devant conserver une voix dans les décisions affectant son propre territoire, conformément à son statut d'autonomie.

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: Aucun gouvernement n'a publié le texte juridique complet, et les détails émergent encore.

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: Les analystes avertissent que le libellé final sur les droits de stationnement, l'accès aux ressources et les engagements financiers auront autant d'importance que le cadre général.

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le Groenland, Pourquoi Maintenant

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: La pertinence du Groenland pour la compétition entre grandes puissances a augmenté considérablement au cours de la dernière décennie.

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: La fonte de la glace arctique ouvre de nouvelles voies de navigation et expose des gisements inexploités d'éléments de terres rares et d'autres minéraux essentiels aux chaînes d'approvisionnement de la défense et de l'énergie propre.

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: Sa position entre l'Amérique du Nord et l'Europe la rend également un nœud naturel pour le radar d'alerte de missiles et le suivi des satellites — un rôle que Pituffik joue depuis la Guerre froide.

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: La Chine a cherché des emprises minières et d'infrastructure dans l'Arctique pendant des années, tandis que la Russie a régulièrement développé sa propre présence militaire dans la région.

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: La justification publique de Washington pour une présence plus importante au Groenland s'est concentrée sur la prévention de ce type même d'empiètement, plutôt que sur l'ambition territoriale pour elle-même.

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## Réaction de Nuuk et Copenhague

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants groenlandais, qui ont longtemps équilibré le désir d'une plus grande indépendance du Danemark avec la prudence face à une emprise plus étroite américaine, ont signalé une acceptation prudente d'un résultat qui maintient le statut politique inchangé de l'île.

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: Les autorités danoises, de leur côté, ont présenté l'accord comme une réaffirmation de l'alliance transatlantique après une période de tension inhabituelle, plutôt qu'une concession.

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: Les autorités européennes avaient suivi le différend de près, craignant que tout mouvement unilatéral américain sur le Groenland puisse établir un précédent indésirable concernant la souveraineté des territoires alliés et partenaires.

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: Le résultat négocié — droits de stationnement élargis en échange du respect de la souveraineté existante — sera probablement lu dans les capitales européennes comme une résolution rassurante.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qui Vient Ensuite

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
segments.tr: Les détails de mise en œuvre, y compris l'ampleur de la nouvelle infrastructure américaine, le nombre de troupes et tous les arrangements économiques avec le Groenland et le Danemark, doivent être élaborés lors de pourparlers ultérieurs.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Les législateurs à Washington et Copenhague peuvent également intervenir avant que les éléments de l'accord ne soient finalisés, et le propre parlement du Groenland cherchera probablement à obtenir des assurances que ses intérêts restent protégés lors de la mise en œuvre de l'accord dans les mois à venir.

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, l'accord marque un désécalade notable d'un différend qui a brièvement soulevé des questions sur la durabilité des alliances américano-européennes — résolu, du moins pour le moment, par une coopération militaire élargie plutôt qu'un changement dans qui gouverne l'île.

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **Auto-governança gronelândesa continuada** — com a expectativa de que Nuuk mantenha uma voz nas decisões que afetam seu próprio território, consistente com seu status de autonomia.

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: Nenhum governo divulgou o texto legal completo publicamente, e os detalhes ainda estão surgindo.

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: Analistas alertam que a linguagem final sobre direitos de base, acesso a recursos e compromissos financeiros importará tanto quanto a estrutura geral.

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Por Que Groenlândia, Por Que Agora

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: A relevância da Groenlândia para a competição entre grandes potências cresceu acentuadamente na última década.

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: O derretimento do gelo ártico está abrindo novas rotas de navegação e expondo depósitos inexplorados de elementos de terras raras e outros minerais críticos para as cadeias de suprimento de defesa e energia limpa.

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: Sua posição entre a América do Norte e a Europa também a torna um nó natural para radar de alerta de mísseis e rastreamento por satélite — um papel que Pituffik desempenhou desde a Guerra Fria.

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: A China tem buscado posições de mineração e infraestrutura no Ártico há anos, enquanto a Rússia expandiu constantemente sua própria presença militar na região.

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: A razão pública de Washington para uma presença maior na Groenlândia tem se concentrado em antecipar exatamente esse tipo de invasão, em vez de ambição territorial por si mesma.

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## Reação de Nuuk e Copenhague

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: Líderes gronelândeses, que por muito tempo equilibraram um desejo de maior independência da Dinamarca com cautela sobre cair sob controle americano mais próximo, sinalizaram aceitação cautelosa de um resultado que mantém o status político da ilha inalterado.

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: Autoridades dinamarquesas, por sua vez, enquadraram o acordo como uma reafirmação da aliança transatlântica após um período de tensão incomum, em vez de uma concessão.

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: Autoridades europeias observaram a disputa atentamente, com receio de que qualquer movimento unilateral dos EUA na Groenlândia pudesse estabelecer um precedente indesejável em relação à soberania de territórios aliados e parceiros.

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: O resultado negociado — direitos de base expandidos em troca do respeito à soberania existente — provavelmente será lido nas capitais europeias como uma resolução reconfortante.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Vem A Seguir

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
segments.tr: Os detalhes de implementação, incluindo a escala de nova infraestrutura dos EUA, números de tropas e quaisquer acordos econômicos com a Groenlândia e Dinamarca, deverão ser acertados em negociações posteriores.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Legisladores em Washington e Copenhague também podem opinar antes que elementos do acordo sejam finalizados, e o próprio parlamento da Groenlândia provavelmente buscará garantias de que seus interesses permaneçam protegidos conforme o acordo é implementado nos próximos meses.

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, o acordo marca uma notável desescalação de uma disputa que brevemente levantou questões sobre a durabilidade das alianças EUA-Europa — resolvida, pelo menos por enquanto, através de cooperação militar expandida em vez de uma mudança em quem governa a ilha.

in.title: 56.000 Penduduk, Satu Pangkalan Permanen: Di Dalam Kesepakatan AS-Denmark Atas Greenland

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## Kesepakatan yang Telah Lama Dirancang

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: Setelah berbulan-bulan retorika yang meningkat dan menggugah kekhawatiran sekutu di seluruh Atlantik, Amerika Serikat dan Denmark telah mencapai kesepakatan mengenai masa depan Greenland, pulau terbesar di dunia dan rumah bagi sekitar 56.000 orang.

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: Pengaturan tersebut menetapkan kehadiran militer AS yang signifikan dan permanen di tanah Greenland sambil secara eksplisit melestarikan kedaulatan Denmark atas wilayah tersebut — sebuah kompromi yang dirancang untuk mengurangi eskalasi salah satu jalan buntu diplomatik yang tidak biasa antara dua sekutu NATO dalam ingatan baru-baru ini.

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: Kesepakatan ini mengikuti periode di mana Presiden Trump berulang kali mengajukan ide bahwa Amerika Serikat harus mengakuisisi atau sebaliknya mengendalikan Greenland sepenuhnya, dengan mengutip lokasi strategisnya dan kekayaan mineralnya.

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: Pejabat Denmark dan Greenland menolak dengan tegas dan konsisten setiap saran bahwa status politik pulau tersebut terbuka untuk negosiasi, bersikeras bahwa keputusan tentang masa depan Greenland berada di tangan penduduk Greenland sendiri dan, berdasarkan istilah pemerintahan mandiri, dengan Kopenhagen.

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Sebenarnya Dikatakan Kesepakatan Ini

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: Alih-alih transfer wilayah, kesepakatan tersebut dilaporkan berpusat pada jejak militer AS yang diperluas dan permanen, dibangun atas dasar pengaturan pertahanan yang telah ada selama beberapa dekade yang terkait dengan Pangkalan Luar Angkasa Pituffik (sebelumnya Pangkalan Udara Thule) di barat laut pulau tersebut.

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: Elemen-elemen kunci yang dijelaskan oleh para pejabat meliputi:

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **Kedaulatan Denmark yang berkelanjutan** — Greenland tetap menjadi bagian dari Kerajaan Denmark, dengan pemerintahnya sendiri di Nuuk mempertahankan wewenang atas urusan domestik.

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **Kehadiran pangkalan AS yang permanen** — memperluas infrastruktur militer Amerika dan personel di luar jejak yang ada, diframing sebagai komitmen keamanan jangka panjang daripada penugasan sementara.

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **Garis keras terhadap kekuatan saingan** — ketentuan yang ditujukan untuk secara permanen memblokir Tiongkok dan Rusia dari membangun infrastruktur militer, pelabuhan, atau ganda di mana pun di pulau tersebut.

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **Pemerintahan mandiri Greenland yang berkelanjutan** — dengan Nuuk diharapkan mempertahankan suara dalam keputusan yang mempengaruhi wilayahnya sendiri, konsisten dengan status pemerintahan mandirinya.

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: Tidak ada pemerintah yang telah merilis teks hukum lengkap secara publik, dan detail masih terus muncul.

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: Para analis memperingatkan bahwa bahasa final tentang hak pembebasan, akses sumber daya, dan komitmen keuangan akan sama pentingnya dengan kerangka kerja yang luas.

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Greenland, Mengapa Sekarang

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: Relevansi Greenland terhadap kompetisi kekuatan besar telah meningkat tajam selama dekade terakhir.

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: Mencairnya es Arktik membuka jalur pelayaran baru dan mengekspos deposito yang belum dimanfaatkan dari elemen tanah jarang dan mineral lain yang penting bagi pertahanan dan rantai pasokan energi bersih.

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: Posisinya antara Amerika Utara dan Eropa juga menjadikannya simpul alami untuk radar peringatan rudal dan pelacakan satelit — peran yang telah dimainkan Pituffik sejak Perang Dingin.

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: Tiongkok telah mencari penopang tambang dan infrastruktur di Arktik selama bertahun-tahun, sementara Rusia terus memperluas kehadiran militer mereka sendiri di wilayah tersebut.

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: Alasan publik Washington untuk jejak Greenland yang lebih besar telah berfokus pada pencegahan jenis pelanggaran itu, bukan ambisi territorial untuk kepentingannya sendiri.

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## Reaksi Dari Nuuk dan Kopenhagen

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: Para pemimpin Greenland, yang telah lama menyeimbangkan keinginan untuk kemandirian yang lebih besar dari Denmark dengan kehati-hatian tentang jatuh di bawah kontrol Amerika yang lebih dekat, telah memberi sinyal penerimaan yang hati-hati terhadap hasil yang mempertahankan status politik pulau tidak berubah.

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: Pejabat Denmark, di pihak mereka, telah membingkai kesepakatan sebagai penegasan kembali aliansi transatlantik setelah periode ketegangan yang tidak biasa, bukan sebagai konsesi.

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: Pejabat Eropa telah memantau sengketa dengan cermat, waspada bahwa setiap gerakan unilateral AS di Greenland dapat menetapkan preseden yang tidak diinginkan mengenai kedaulatan wilayah sekutu dan mitra.

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: Hasil negosiasi — hak pembebasan yang diperluas sebagai imbalan menghormati kedaulatan yang ada — kemungkinan akan dibaca di ibu kota Eropa sebagai resolusi yang meyakinkan.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Yang Akan Datang Selanjutnya

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
segments.tr: Detail implementasi, termasuk skala infrastruktur AS baru, jumlah pasukan, dan setiap pengaturan ekonomi dengan Greenland dan Denmark, diharapkan dapat diselesaikan dalam pembicaraan lanjutan.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both Washington and Copenhagen may also weigh in before elements of the deal are finalized, and Greenland's own parliament is likely to seek assurances that its interests remain protected as the agreement is implemented in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Pembuat undang-undang di Washington dan Kopenhagen juga dapat memberikan masukan sebelum elemen kesepakatan disepakati, dan parlemen Greenland itu sendiri kemungkinan akan mencari jaminan bahwa kepentingannya tetap terlindungi saat kesepakatan diimplementasikan dalam beberapa bulan ke depan.

segments.src: For now, the deal marks a notable de-escalation of a dispute that briefly raised questions about the durability of US-European alliances — resolved, at least for the moment, through expanded military cooperation rather than a change in who governs the island.
segments.tr: Untuk sekarang, kesepakatan menandai pengurangan eskalasi yang nyata dari sengketa yang secara singkat mengangkat pertanyaan tentang ketahanan aliansi AS-Eropa — diselesaikan, setidaknya untuk saat ini, melalui kerjasama militer yang diperluas bukan perubahan dalam siapa yang memerintah pulau tersebut.

ja.title: 56,000人の住民と米国の常設基地：グリーンランドをめぐる米国・デンマーク協力内容

segments.src: ## A Deal Years in the Making
segments.tr: ## 数年がかりでまとまった協力

segments.src: After months of escalating rhetoric that unsettled allies across the Atlantic, the United States and Denmark have reached an agreement covering the future of Greenland, the world's largest island and home to roughly 56,000 people.
segments.tr: 大西洋の同盟国を不安にさせる数ヶ月間の修辞の応酬の後、米国とデンマークは世界最大の島であり、約56,000人の住民が住むグリーンランドの将来を扱う協力に合意した。

segments.src: The arrangement establishes a significant, permanent US military presence on Greenlandic soil while explicitly preserving Danish sovereignty over the territory — a compromise designed to de-escalate one of the more unusual diplomatic standoffs between two NATO allies in recent memory.
segments.tr: この協力はグリーンランド領土上の米国軍の重要で恒久的なプレゼンスを確立する一方で、その領土に対するデンマークの主権を明示的に保持している――最近の記憶の中で二つのNATO同盟国間における最も異例的な外交的対立の一つを緩和するために設計された妥協案である。

segments.src: The agreement follows a period in which President Trump repeatedly floated the idea that the United States should acquire or otherwise control Greenland outright, citing its strategic location and mineral wealth.
segments.tr: この協力は、トランプ大統領が米国がグリーンランドを取得するか、あるいは完全に支配すべきという考えを繰り返し提案していた時期に続くものである。その根拠は、戦略的な立地と鉱物資源の豊かさである。

segments.src: Danish and Greenlandic officials pushed back firmly and consistently on any suggestion that the island's political status was open for negotiation, insisting that decisions about Greenland's future rest with Greenlanders themselves and, under the terms of home rule, with Copenhagen.
segments.tr: デンマークとグリーンランドの当局者は、島の政治的地位が交渉の対象となるという提案に対して強硬で一貫した反論を行い、グリーンランドの将来に関する決定はグリーンランド人自身とホームルール制度に基づきコペンハーゲンにあるべきだと主張した。

segments.src: ## What the Agreement Actually Says
segments.tr: ## 協力が実際に述べていること

segments.src: Rather than a transfer of territory, the deal reportedly centers on an expanded and permanent US military footprint, building on the decades-old defense arrangement tied to Pituffik Space Base (formerly Thule Air Base) in the island's northwest.
segments.tr: 領土の譲渡ではなく、この協力は米国軍のプレゼンスの拡大と恒久化を中心としており、島の北西部にあるPituffik宇宙基地（旧Thule航空基地）に関連する数十年前の防衛協力に基づいている。

segments.src: Key elements described by officials include:
segments.tr: 当局者によって説明された主要な要素には以下が含まれる：

segments.src: - **Continued Danish sovereignty** — Greenland remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark, with its own government in Nuuk retaining authority over domestic affairs.
segments.tr: - **デンマークの主権の継続** ――グリーンランドはデンマーク王国の一部であり続け、ヌークの独自政府が国内問題に対する権限を保持する。

segments.src: - **A permanent US base presence** — expanding American military infrastructure and personnel beyond the existing footprint, framed as a long-term security commitment rather than a temporary posting.
segments.tr: - **米国軍の恒久的な基地プレゼンス** ――既存のプレゼンスを超えて米国の軍事インフラと要員を拡大し、一時的な駐留ではなく長期的な安全保障約束として位置付けられている。

segments.src: - **A hard line on rival powers** — provisions intended to permanently block China and Russia from establishing military, port, or dual-use infrastructure anywhere on the island.
segments.tr: - **ライバル国に対する強硬姿勢** ――中国とロシアが島のどこにでも軍事、港湾、またはデュアルユース目的のインフラを構築することを永久に防止することを意図した規定。

segments.src: - **Continued Greenlandic self-governance** — with Nuuk expected to retain a voice in decisions affecting its own territory, consistent with its home-rule status.
segments.tr: - **グリーンランドの自治の継続** ――ホームルール地位と一致して、ヌークが自分の領土に影響を与える決定についての発言権を保持することが期待されている。

segments.src: Neither government has released the full legal text publicly, and details are still emerging.
segments.tr: どちらの政府も完全な法的文書を公開していないため、詳細はまだ明らかになっている。

segments.src: Analysts caution that final language on basing rights, resource access, and financial commitments will matter as much as the broad framework.
segments.tr: 分析家は、基地設置権、資源アクセス、および財政的約束に関する最終的な文言が広い枠組みと同じくらい重要であることを警告している。

segments.src: ## Why Greenland, Why Now
segments.tr: ## なぜグリーンランドなのか、なぜ今なのか

segments.src: Greenland's relevance to great-power competition has grown sharply over the past decade.
segments.tr: グリーンランドの大国間競争における関連性は過去10年間で急速に高まった。

segments.src: Melting Arctic ice is opening new shipping lanes and exposing untapped deposits of rare earth elements and other minerals critical to defense and clean-energy supply chains.
segments.tr: 北極圏の氷の融解は新しい海上航路を開き、防衛とクリーンエネルギー供給チェーンに不可欠なレアアース元素およびその他の鉱物の未開発鉱床を露出させている。

segments.src: Its position between North America and Europe also makes it a natural node for missile-warning radar and satellite tracking — a role Pituffik has played since the Cold War.
segments.tr: 北米とヨーロッパの間の位置はミサイル警戒レーダーと衛星追跡の自然なノードとなっており、これは冷戦以来Pituffikが果たしてきた役割である。

segments.src: China has sought mining and infrastructure footholds in the Arctic for years, while Russia has steadily expanded its own military presence in the region.
segments.tr: 中国は数年間、北極圏での採鉱とインフラの足がかりを求め続けてきた一方で、ロシアはこの地域での自身の軍事プレゼンスを着実に拡大している。

segments.src: Washington's public rationale for a larger Greenland footprint has centered on preempting exactly that kind of encroachment, rather than territorial ambition for its own sake.
segments.tr: グリーンランドでのより大きなプレゼンスに対するワシントンの公式な根拠は、それ自体のための領土的野心ではなく、まさにその種の侵略を先制することに焦点を当てている。

segments.src: ## Reaction From Nuuk and Copenhagen
segments.tr: ## ヌークとコペンハーゲンからの反応

segments.src: Greenlandic leaders, who have long balanced a desire for greater independence from Denmark with wariness about falling under closer American control, have signaled cautious acceptance of an outcome that keeps the island's political status unchanged.
segments.tr: デンマークからのより大きな独立への欲望とより密接なアメリカの支配下に陥ることへの警戒を長い間バランスさせてきたグリーンランド指導者たちは、島の政治的地位を変わらないままに保つ結果に対する慎重な受け入れの意思を示した。

segments.src: Danish officials, for their part, have framed the deal as a reaffirmation of the transatlantic alliance after a period of unusual strain, rather than a concession.
segments.tr: 一方、デンマークの当局者は、この協力を譲歩ではなく、異例の緊張の時期後の大西洋を挟む同盟の再確認として位置付けた。

segments.src: European officials had watched the dispute closely, wary that any unilateral US move on Greenland could set an unwelcome precedent regarding the sovereignty of allied and partner territories.
segments.tr: ヨーロッパの当局者は紛争を注視してきたが、グリーンランドに対する一方的な米国の行動が同盟国およびパートナー領土の主権に関する歓迎されない前例を確立する可能性を懸念していた。

segments.src: The negotiated outcome — expanded basing rights in exchange for respecting existing sovereignty — is likely to be read in European capitals as a reassuring resolution.
segments.tr: 交渉された結果――既存の主権を尊重する見返りに基地設置権を拡大――はヨーロッパの首都で安心できる解決策として読み取られるであろう。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 次は何か

segments.src: Implementation details, including the scale of new US infrastructure, troop numbers, and any economic arrangements with Greenland and Denmark, are expected to be worked out in follow-on talks.
